# Core Layer

## LAST UPDATE: 2026-08-17

This revision supersedes earlier historical wording that implied `Core`, `Infrastructure`, and `Tenant` were the canonical physical layout for project folders.

The canonical physical project layout is now:

- `Prismata/Projects/Applications`
- `Prismata/Projects/Services`
- `Prismata/Projects/Tooling`

`Core` / `Infrastructure` / `Tenant` remain useful as conceptual classification categories, but they are not the authoritative repository path structure.

                            CORE LAYER (THE PHYSICS)
                            =========================
                                ┌───────────────┐
                                │   SCHEMAS     │
                                └──────┬────────┘
                                       v
        ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │ primary config schema — defines project structure            │
        │ flowspec schema — defines workflow structure                 │
        │ jobspec schema — defines job execution structure             │
        │ project classification schema — defines type/role rules      │
        │ interface capability schema — defines interface structure    │
        └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

                               ┌───────────────┐
                               │  TAXONOMIES   │
                               └──────┬────────┘
                                      v
        ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │ colour taxonomy — semantic hue families                      │
        │ role taxonomy — allowed roles                                │
        │ project_type taxonomy — Applications/Services/Tooling        │
        │ interface taxonomy — semantic interface categories           │
        └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

                               ┌───────────────┐
                               │  SUBSTRATES   │
                               └──────┬────────┘
                                      v
        ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │ logging substrate — unified logging behaviour                │
        │ compositor substrate — windowed UI behaviour                 │
        │ interface grammar — rules for UI/CLI/TUI                     │
        │ colour engine — OKLCH + brightness + hue logic               │
        └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Notes:

- `project_type` now maps conceptually to `Applications`, `Services`, and `Tooling` for physical placement under `Prismata/Projects/`.
- Keep using `Core`/`Infrastructure`/`Tenant` as conceptual classifications where helpful, but prefer the physical grouping for repository layout and CI paths.
- Historical references to `Core`/`Infrastructure`/`Tenant` as physical path roots should be read as historical context only, not as the current canonical folder structure.

History
-------
- Canonicalized from `../../archive/project-classification/2026-08-17-Core_Layer.md` (latest snapshot). See `CHANGELOG.md` for a short history and `../../archive/project-classification/` for full dated snapshots.
